title: Rani Sati Dadi Mandir Darshan
playlist: Maa Durga aur Devi ki Kathayein
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Rani Sati Dadi mandir mein kya khaas?

scenes.prompt: Close-up devotional darshan of a calm Dadi Maa goddess murti in a Rajasthani temple sanctum, serene face in the middle of the frame, red chunari, gold jewellery and a silver crown, marigold garlands, lit brass diyas, soft golden glow, no fire besides the small diyas
scenes.tts: रानी सती दादी मंदिर में क्या है ख़ास?
scenes.sub: Rani Sati Dadi mandir mein kya hai khaas?
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the soft golden glow gently pulses, a few petals drift in the foreground

scenes.prompt: A large white marble Rajasthani temple with tall shikharas and saffron flags in a Shekhawati town, clear evening sky, golden light, calm courtyard, no people
scenes.tts: ये मंदिर राजस्थान के झुंझुनूं शहर में है।
scenes.sub: Ye mandir Rajasthan ke Jhunjhunu shehar mein hai.
scenes.animate: the saffron flags flutter gently in the evening breeze

scenes.prompt: Devotees' hands offering red chunari and marigold flowers at a temple sanctum, brass diyas glowing, warm light, no faces, devotional illustration
scenes.tts: मान्यता है, यहाँ दादी जी को नारायणी देवी भी कहते हैं।
scenes.sub: Manyata hai, yahan Dadi ji ko Narayani Devi bhi kehte hain.
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly and a few marigold petals drift down

scenes.prompt: Close-up of the Dadi Maa goddess murti, calm serene face in the middle of the frame, red chunari, gold crown, marigold garlands and glowing diyas in the foreground, sacred sanctum
scenes.tts: श्रद्धा से बोलिए, जय दादी माँ!
scenes.sub: Shraddha se boliye, Jai Dadi Maa!
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still, the diya flames glow and flicker softly

scenes.tts: कल फिर नया दर्शन। लाइक, शेयर, सब्सक्राइब करें। जय रानी सती दादी!
scenes.sub: Kal phir naya darshan. Like, Share, Subscribe karein. Jai Rani Sati Dadi!

youtube_description:
Rani Sati Dadi Mandir darshan, Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan). Manyata hai ki yahan Dadi ji ko Narayani Devi roop mein pooja jata hai.
रानी सती दादी मंदिर, झुंझुनूं के दर्शन।
Sati pratha Bharat mein kanoon (Sati Nivaran Adhiniyam 1987) dwara pratibandhit hai; yeh video sirf itihas aur aastha ki jaankari ke liye hai, is pratha ko badhava nahi deta.
Jai Shree Shyam 🙏
Chitra AI dwara banaye gaye hain (sanketik). Ye asli darshan nahi hain.
Achha laga to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein.
